title: Runtime source lease: ordinary client account binding and native planner seam

conditions.description: At published c5c2666a8, ClientConfig.fs/Runtime.fs have no account binding; AccountBinding is only supplied to read-only CLI preview or unrelated WQ10 migration fence. Existing B1 WorkQueueReactiveWake.Coordinator requires WQ07 Activated whereas accepted W12 native CAS requires LegacyActive, and native planner is scripts/jarvis-ledger-planner.mjs (Phase2 adapter still explicitly denies capacity). Please reconcile exact ordinary ClientConfig/runtime binding + planner/materialization lease or identify already existing authoritative production binding and planner invocation. No independent auth, credentials, human per-dispatch approval, new host, migration, or live enablement. I am proceeding with independent existing-auth verified read adapter against accepted W12 now; actual Program registration cannot claim a configured account until this seam is established.
